name: Wisp Light · Death · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• A glowing wisp where it lands: light level 15, floats in the air, permanent, removed with a hit
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• A glowing wisp above your head: light level 15, floats in the air, permanent, removed with a hit
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
